purpose: Platform-neutral synthetic counterexample: separate omitted history from insufficient nonlinear short-context features. No vehicle/controller experiments.

diagnostic_recipe.folds: leave one whole diagnostic recording out
diagnostic_recipe.replacement_control: older features from other training recordings; held-out donors use training recordings only

observed_cycle.transition: Rotate latent coordinates one position left; u=0. Fully observed invertible transform, first-order Markov.

hold_witness: Repeat the latest observation. A deliberately misspecified predictor for isolating diagnostic behavior, not a fitted learner.
reuse: Three hidden-delay models and three process-noise models from prior synthetic investigations. Those diagnostic records were previously inspected.

comparison.extended_features: The same additive polynomial short basis, plus raw older history; no older powers or interactions.
comparison.normalization: Training-fold-only raw short normalization, polynomial expansion, then train-only affine ridge scaling.
comparison.folds: Leave one whole recording out; reuse v1 donor assignments.
comparison.short_basis: Coordinatewise powers 1..degree of normalized short-context channels, without cross-channel products; fixed additive basis limits growth to degree times short-context width.

measurement: Per-output residual RMS and extra-history MSE reduction relative to the same short polynomial basis; all cases and degrees reported, no best-degree selection or API change.
claim_limits: A richer predictor can falsify a particular memory interpretation; persistent gains still do not uniquely identify memory. The cyclic case has repeated observations and is an analytical witness, not a realistic data-efficiency benchmark.
